question: Does frozen Demian recurrence improve navigation beyond matched fitted memoryless controls in a partially observed dynamic maze?
hypothesis_scope: Frozen behavioral baseline, not learning through experience.
episode_rule: Training: orientation-major, condition-major, replicate-major; seed=training_base+100*orientation+10*condition_index+replicate. Evaluation: condition-major, replicate0..5; orientation=evaluation_orientations[replicate%4], seed=evaluation_base+10*condition_index+replicate. Exactly48training and24evaluation episodes per parameter seed/policy.
disturbances: Periodic period chosen from4/6/8 with uniform initial phase. Switch changes at tick2: invert tick1door status and use an8tick period with4tick blocks. Full tapes saved. Same tapes across policies and parameter seeds; random policy draws use seed+world_seed.
preflight_ruling: Replace planned tick48 switch with tick2; successful static-open route lasts4ticks. Initial heldout layouts differ by D4 orientation only; novel topology transfer remains later.
observations: 49public features: row-major3x3cell one-hots wall/floor/open-door/closed-door; unseen/closed/open door indicator; two signed goal bearings; energy/96; previous-action one-hot and moved/blocked flags. Energy is an explicit within-episode timing proxy; no absolute door clock or condition flag.
encoder: Stateless .25scaled public features injected into fast; feature i uses coordinate i%hidden_size. Width16 is engineering smoke only; width256 has no feature-slot collisions. Existing cue-task encoders remain unchanged.
teacher: Static map plus own public observation/action history; unobserved door initially believed open, last visible door state retained. At a visible closed door entry, wait once to observe again, then detour if still closed. Opening resets that wait allowance. Otherwise shortest-path action under current belief. No future tape or hidden current door access.
training_coverage: Replicate0: teacher actions. Replicate1: force north at first tick; replicate2: force wait at first tick. At every visited state label the teacher's desired action, recording forced actual action separately. No online/evaluation corrections.
fitting: Per parameter seed, fit three external five-action ridge heads: intact full state, separately collected per-tick-reset full state, current public observations. Same48training trajectories/teacher labels; train-only per-feature normalization; ridgealpha1, unpenalized intercept. Freeze fits before evaluation. Confirmation seeds receive their own permitted training-layout fits; no zero-shot decoder claim.
reset_semantics: Full Demian state and runtime reset to the same seed-specific initial snapshot at episode start. Per-tick reset additionally restores that snapshot before each observation. Acute uses intact head; matched reset has its own fitted head. No persistent inter-episode learning variables.
actions: north/south/east/west/wait; unmasked argmax logits. Every accepted action costs1; blocked moves and wait also cost1. Observe current door, execute action, advance time. Closed door blocks entry; occupant may leave. Goal/exhaustion terminate.
primary: Per-seed success fraction and failure-penalized cost (96for failures). Development support requires recurrent success advantage>=.10 over BOTH reset_matched and observation in>=3/4seeds, with cost no greater than both in those seeds. Fresh confirmation uses>=5/6seeds. Report static and dynamic conditions separately; no outcome-dependent threshold selection.
secondary: Teacher-frame action accuracy on heldout layouts, blocked moves, first-goal time, movement recovery after blockage, recurrence-reset effect, channel/route norms and exact public-observation replay. Record switch time elapsed, door visibility and observed door changes separately; a tick2switch does not necessarily obstruct direct traversal. Oracle static distances establish solvability, not dynamic optimality.
memory_demand: Validate east→west scripted histories from the base junction: current public observations/energy/acknowledgement match for open/closed doors, prior local door observations differ, teacher next actions east/south differ. This is a task-validity check; agent exploitation must be measured separately.
inference_unit: Parameter seed; worlds shared across seeds, episodes/checkpoints/policies dependent. No claim of universal environment generalization.
claim_boundary: Frozen system with externally fitted action heads. Navigation/regulation, recurrence contribution and readout failure remain separate; no internal learning, smart-routing mechanism, AFP or architecture superiority claim.
